swing/grf_lead_vertical_bw.ref: PRIMARY: 4th-order Butterworth low-pass 50 Hz, zero-lag (filtfilt), applied before the peak - Rachnavy et al. 2026 (PMC13111475, 4th-order 50 Hz) and Liu et al. 2026 (PMC13272296, 50 Hz); MEDIUM confidence, NO consensus (GRF cutoffs 6-50 Hz in the literature: Lin 2023 / Li 2026 6 Hz, Harada 2023 12 Hz, Chen 2024 14 Hz); zero-lag is OUR choice (not stated for GRF in any source). Secondary guard: >=3 consecutive samples (harness heuristic, no source). WINDOW: top of backswing -> impact is supported (Worsfold 2007 PMC3794489, Liu 2025 PMC12416643, Lin 2023 PMC10215287, Han 2019 MED/31042142: lead-foot peak in the downswing, before impact) + 20 ms EVENT-JITTER ALLOWANCE (our choice, not a literature value). BAND: 1.7 BW upper limit has NO source (PROVISIONAL, unverified); the only confirmed driver figure is 0.84 BW lead foot (Worsfold 2007). Notes: <local-path> (Data Agent 2026-10-19)
